errors.evidence: The description omits one of the categories from the x-axis: "诚信" (Integrity).
The numerical range of the vertical axis is from 0 to 1, not 0.6 to 0.9.
The values on the y-axis are F1 scores, which are represented as decimals from 0 to 1, not percentages.
The vertical axis does not have a visible label. The caption mentions "(F1)", but it is not an axis label.

errors.text_span: 灰色柱状图代表“忽略”的性能，黄色柱状图代表“抽取”的性能
errors.evidence: The legend indicates that the yellow bars represent "激活" (Activation) and the grey bars represent "抑制" (Inhibition), not "忽略" (Ignore) and "抽取" (Extract).

errors.text_span: 最矮柱状图是“文明”的 F1 值约为 0.65
errors.evidence: The shortest bar in the chart is the yellow bar for the "平等" (Equality) category, with a value of approximately 0.64.

errors.text_span: 最长柱状图是“友善”的 F1 值约为 0.9
errors.evidence: The longest bar in the chart is the grey bar for the "爱国" (Patriotism) category, which has a value of 1.0.

errors.text_span: 其他柱状图的 F1 值之间的长度将近，大致位于 0.7 到 0.8 之间
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate generalization, as many bars have values well above 0.8 (e.g., around 0.9, 0.95, and even 1.0).

errors.text_span: 所有柱状图都已按视觉长度由短到长排列
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted by height. The categories on the x-axis are arranged in a fixed, non-value-based order.
The description fails to explain the grouping structure of the bars, i.e., that for each category on the x-axis, there is a pair of bars corresponding to "激活" (Activation) and "抑制" (Inhibition).
